title: Weak-error and length-dependent BPP coincide
statement: Let $c$ be a natural number and let $L$ be a language of bit strings. The language $L$ has a polynomial-time verifier whose probability of the correct answer on inputs of length $n$ is at least $1/2+\min\{1/6,(n+1)^{-c}\}$ if and only if it has a polynomial-time verifier with that same success-probability bound.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language of bit strings
